sn35.245:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅki upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn35.245:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:1.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:2.1: atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhāveyyākaraṇena yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn35.245:2.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:2.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:3.1: atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhāveyyākaraṇena yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn35.245:3.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:3.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:4.1: atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhāveyyākaraṇena yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn35.245:4.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:4.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu yaṅkiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbantaṃ nirodhadhammanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:5.1: atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhāveyyākaraṇena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca idhāhaṃ bhante yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocaṃ
sn35.245:5.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:5.3: evaṃ vutte bhante so bhikkhu maṃ etadavoca

sn35.245:5.6: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.

sn35.245:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhu purisassa kiṃsuko adiṭṭhapubbo assa.
sn35.245:6.2: so yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya upasaṅkamitvā taṃ purisaṃ evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:6.5: kāḷako kho ambho purisa kiṃsuko seyyathāpi jhāmakhāṇūti.
sn35.245:6.6: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādisovassa kiṃsuko yathā tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.
sn35.245:7.1: atha kho so bhikkhu puriso asantuṭṭho tassa purisassa pañhāveyyākaraṇena yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya upasaṅkamitvā taṃ purisaṃ evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:7.4: lohitako kho ambho purisa kiṃsuko seyyathāpi maṃsapesīti.
sn35.245:7.5: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādisovassa kiṃsuko yathāpi tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.
sn35.245:7.6: atha kho so bhikkhu puriso asantuṭṭho tassa purisassa paṇhāveyyākaraṇena yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya upasaṅkamitvā taṃ purisaṃ evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:7.9: ocīrakajāto kho ambho purisa kiṃsuko ādiṇṇasipāṭiko seyyathāpi sirīsoti.
sn35.245:7.10: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādisovassa kiṃsuko yathāpi tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.
sn35.245:7.11: atha kho so bhikkhu puriso asantuṭaṭho tassa purisassa pañhāveyyākaraṇena yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya upasaṅkamitvā taṃ purisaṃ evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:7.14: bahalapattapalāso saṇḍacchāyo kho ambho purisa kiṃsuko seyyathāpi nigrodhoti.
sn35.245:7.15: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādisovassa kiṃsuko yathāpi tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.
sn35.245:7.16: evameva kho bhikkhu yathā yathā adhimuttānaṃ tesaṃ sappurisānaṃ dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hoti tathā tathā kho chekehi sappurisehi byākataṃ.
sn35.245:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhu rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷhaṃ pākāratoraṇaṃ chadvāraṃ
sn35.245:8.2: tatrassa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
sn35.245:8.3: puratthimāya disāya āgantvā sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ taṃ dovārikaṃ evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:8.7: atha kho taṃ sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ nagarasāmissa yathābhūtaṃ vacanaṃ nīyādetvā yathāgatamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya.
sn35.245:8.10: dakkhiṇāya disāya āgantvā sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ taṃ dovārikaṃ evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:8.14: atha kho taṃ sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ nagarasāmissa yathābhūtaṃ vacanaṃ nīyādetvā yathāgatamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya.
sn35.245:9.1: upamā kho myāyaṃ bhikkhu katā atthassa viññāpanāya
sn35.245:9.3: nagaranti kho bhikkhu imassetaṃ cātummahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsūpacayassa niccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammassa.
sn35.245:9.4: chadvārāti kho bhikkhu channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.245:9.5: dovārikoti kho bhikkhu satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.245:9.6: sīghaṃ dūtayuganti kho bhikkhu samathavipassanānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.245:9.8: majjhe siṅghāṭakāti kho bhikkhu catunnetaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ adhivacanaṃ
sn35.245:9.10: yathābhūtaṃ vacananti kho bhikkhu nibbānassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.245:9.11: yathāgatamaggoti kho bhikkhu ariyassetaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ. seyyathīdaṃ.
